Synthetic French speech fixture for Java native language-option tests.

Text:
Aujourd'hui, le soleil brille. Nous allons nous promener dans le parc et admirer les fleurs.

Format: mono PCM16LE WAV, 16000 Hz, 7.4825 seconds.
WAV SHA-256: 95fd1e4a6725a388cd3531ed74f65e899407529b7d981ac1dce2d3cee7e7917e

Generation:
Piper TTS 1.8.0, fr_FR-siwis-medium, --sentence-silence 0.7.
Voice ONNX SHA-256: 641d1ab097da2b81128c076810edb052b385decc8be3381814802a64a73baf99
Resampled from 22050 Hz with Python 3.12 audioop.ratecv (width 2, mono),
then padded with 0.5 seconds of leading and 1 second of trailing silence.
This is newly synthesized speech, not a recording copied from the training data.

Voice model card:
https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices/blob/main/fr/fr_FR/siwis/medium/MODEL_CARD

Training-data attribution:
Yamagishi, Junichi; Honnet, Pierre-Edouard; Garner, Philip; Lazaridis, Alexandros
(2017). The SIWIS French Speech Synthesis Database. University of Edinburgh.
https://hdl.handle.net/10283/2353
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

With the pinned multilingual Nemotron model, omission loses the second sentence.
Both fr-FR and auto must include "dans le parc" in streaming and final output.
